moving_occurrences.function: Biases the plunger outward during lash adjustment.

moving_occurrences.name: Lifter check-valve retainer
moving_occurrences.function: Retains the check-valve spring at the plunger base.

moving_occurrences.name: Lifter check-valve spring
moving_occurrences.function: Biases the check valve toward its seat.

moving_occurrences.name: Lifter check valve
moving_occurrences.function: Closes the oil chamber during lift so the lifter transmits force.

moving_occurrences.name: Lifter plunger
moving_occurrences.function: Moves inside the body to take up valve-train clearance. Its bottom closes the hydraulic chamber around the small check-valve port.

moving_occurrences.name: Lifter metering disc
moving_occurrences.function: Meters the oil delivered toward the pushrod cup.

moving_occurrences.name: Lifter pushrod cup
moving_occurrences.function: Supports the spherical pushrod end and admits lubricating oil.

moving_occurrences.name: Lifter retaining ring
moving_occurrences.function: Keeps the internal parts inside the lifter body.
